title: Perfect matching in bounded-error polynomial time
statement: The language of encodings of Boolean adjacency matrices whose associated bipartite graph has a perfect matching is decidable by a probabilistic Turing machine in polynomial time, with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members and at most $1/3$ on nonmembers.
